feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Why the Supreme Court's ballroom ruling could matter beyond the ballroom
entry.summary: Georgetown Law professor Stephen Vladeck explains the separation-of-powers questions raised by the Supreme Court's decision on the White House ballroom.

entry.title: Whistleblower claims USPS plan for Trump's mail voting order could 'derail' midterms
entry.summary: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

entry.title: A makeover for college: No gym, no meal plan and two years of work
entry.summary: A new model in Vermont emphasizes hands-on learning while stripping away frills like gyms and meal plans that increase costs. Other newly created institutions are also reimagining college.

entry.title: 'It can outthink me': How a major manufacturer came to embrace AI
entry.summary: GE Appliances is leaning heavily into artificial intelligence to improve quality and efficiency on the factory floor.

entry.title: Judge to decide if Tyler Robinson will go to trial in Charlie Kirk murder case
entry.summary: Utah District Judge Tony Graf Jr. will hear arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide if there's enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

entry.title: AI wealth is creating a 'mansion shortage' and upending San Francisco's housing market
entry.summary: Spiking prices and rental bidding wars are raising fears of more displacement in a city where previous tech booms and a housing shortage have already driven out many.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Supreme Court allows President Trump to continue construction of White House ballroom, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll steps down, world finance leaders meet in North Carolina for G-20 summit.

entry.title: Chance for more rain makes rescue operations perilous after Grand Canyon flooding
entry.summary: Ongoing rain chances are making search and rescue operations at the Grand Canyon more hazardous following Saturday's deadly flooding.

entry.title: As Democratic-led states block ICE cooperation deals, local sheriffs push back in court
entry.summary: President Trump's ambitious deportation goals depend on the cooperation of local law enforcement, but some states don't want to take part. Now, sheriffs who want to cooperate with ICE are suing.

entry.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns
entry.summary: The Army's top civilian leader has resigned. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down after 18 months on the job, the White House says. It's the latest in a series of military leadership shakeups.
